Agent Name: CSVHandling_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly assumed the first-position ball has the highest chance of being ejected because it is “in the firing line,” overlooking that when pistons 2 or 3 fire, the first-position ball is released without ejection. They failed to compute the actual probabilities across the random piston firings; in fact, ball 1 is ejected with probability 1/3, ball 2 with 5/9, and ball 3 with 17/27, making 3 the optimal choice.
